newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST -- Italy November PPI seen up 0.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST -- Italy November PPI seen up 0.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italy's producer prices are seen rising slightly in November 1996, but analysts said the data should confirm the absence of any inflationary pressures.
Analysts polled by Reuters on Tuesday said the slight increase in PPI is due to the rise of oil prices. Without this factor, PPI would have been steady in November, they said.
Italy's national statistics body ISTAT will publish November producer and wholesale prices on Thursday January 16.
Analysts see PPI rising 0.1 percent monthly, with forecasts ranging from flat to 0.5 percent. Wholesale prices are seen steady to slightly rising in a zero to 0.2 percent range on a monthly basis.
October PPI rose 0.2 percent on a monthly basis and 0.4 percent year-on-year. In November 1995, producer prices were steady monthly and rose 7.2 percent year-on-year.
In October 1996, wholesale prices showed a 0.9 percent increase on a monthly basis and a 2.1 percent increase year-on-year. In November 1995, WPI rose 0.2 percent monthly and 10.4 percent annually.
